primary.title: Talent crunch may hamper Sebi’s PMS revamp
primary.summary: Demand for diversification beyond Indian markets is rising, but building teams with the expertise to invest across geographies, currencies and regulatory regimes will take time, as few Indian funds currently invest overseas.
